CustomMetadata.label: AM Patient Treatment Planning Follow Up

values.value: Use when following up on an existing patient treatment planning case where the initial requirements have already been communicated. Addresses provider questions without repeating the full pre-treatment checklist.

Dear [Contact.FirstName],
Thank you for your follow-up regarding Case #[Case.CaseNumber] for [Account.Name].
[Address the provider's specific questions here based on the email thread above.]
If you have any additional questions before the treatment date, please reply to this email or call our Provider Services line directly.
Warm regards, [User.FirstName] [User.LastName] Provider Services Representative Allergan Moxie
